name: ModCloth

prices.note: Like-for-like item: women's jeans. products.json for the Denim collection: 70 products (page 2 empty), 34 jeans/denim pants by product_type. Regular price = no compare_at above price and no sale/markdown/final-sale tag; 14 excluded. All 20 regular-price jeans are from Dangerfield (vendor 'Dangerfield US'), in AU sizes 4–20, many embroidered or printed. The 0–26W sizes seen were on sale-tagged EZ Apparel styles, so not stored.

notes: Homepage title: 'Shop Vintage Outfits // Vintage Style Clothing // ModCloth'. kind=retailer: homepage lists outside labels such as Princess Highway, Dangerfield, Orchid Bloom, Sleepy Peach, Chelsea Crew, Leg Avenue and Sock Candy alongside ModCloth's own collaborations.

About page: 'Born in a Pittsburgh dorm room in 2002'; 'inclusive sizing, standout style, and just the right touch of nostalgia'. HQ not on site; Wikipedia: Los Angeles, California; founders Eric Koger and Susan Gregg Koger; Nogin acquired it in May 2021 and filed Chapter 11 in December 2023 (plan confirmed April 2024), so the current owner is left empty.

Shipping: free ground shipping on eligible orders over $150, contiguous USA only. Express transit times are listed for Canada, Australia and the UK, but the page doesn't confirm standard shipping there, so only US is stored.
Returns: request within 30 days of delivery; $14 per-order fee unless Checkout+ was bought; final sale not returnable.
Sizes: size charts are images; the sale banner reads 'XS-4X' and the navigation has 'Shop Plus Sizes'.
